title: ExyliaSimpleCommands
description: Create simple informative commands for your velocity proxy
body: # ExyliaSimpleCommands ### Informational commands for Velocity --- ## Features - Create commands like `/discord`, `/store`, `/ips` - Full MiniMessage support - Optional centered messages - Optional permissions per command - Unlimited aliases - Hot reload ## Admin Commands - `/simplecommands reload` – Reload configuration - `/simplecommands list` – List registered commands ## Permissions - `simplecommands.admin` – Admin commands ## Configuration Example ```yml commands: discord: aliases: ["dc"] permission: "" centered: true messages: - "Discord" - "Click here" ```` ## Requirements * Velocity 3.4.0+ * Java 21+ --- ## Support Need help? Visit our support at: [https://link.exylia.net/@services](https://link.exylia.net/@services) Made with ❤️ by DiGround | Exylia Services
